items.html: *And with this you will understand why in the first two years the child does not eat by himself, but needs nursing of milk. The reason is that his mother must clarify for him those three Sefirot that remained, for he has no power in his hand to clarify them. And the milk that the infant nurses — behold, certainly, the heart within him carries everything first to his Keter, and afterward to the Mochin, and afterward to the body. For such is the order of his ascent, as is known from the secret of man's eating, for the king, which is the Mochin, eats first.
